name: pose_catalogue_50_left
description: Half of the 100 catalogue poses, the ones assigned to the left hand (alternating in catalogue order); the other half is in the other hand's file. The 100 catalogue poses of docs/pose_catalogue_100.md, camera only, bare left hand; pictures are MyoHand renders (palm view, side view), not photographs. Written by scripts/leap/pose_catalogue_protocol.py.
setup: camera only, bare hand, palm toward the camera about 30 cm above it, held still 3 s
